question: With which mantra should fragrance, flowers, and incense be offered?
premises: Fragrance, flowers, and incense are to be offered.
The same mantra rule applies to them.
The mantra is the one formed by their own name.
inference: Fragrance, flowers, and incense should likewise be offered with the mantra of their own name.
plain_english: Fragrance, flowers, and incense should likewise be offered with the mantra of their own name.
